Dear Famliving Team,

I am writing to report a few issues that require maintenance:

1.  There is no hot water available in any of the rooms.
2.  The drain in the master bedroom is draining very slowly.
3.  The TV remote in the master bedroom is not working.

Kindly assist in resolving these matters as soon as possible.

Regards,
Olugbenga Sanyaolu
